source_contract_catalog.scope: authority metadata and expected contract-source discovery only; runtime conformance remains independently evidence-gated

evidence: Mesh now catalogs Glaze UI as the authority for design, interaction, accessibility, adaptive behavior, and visual presentation and points consumers to the Glaze UI conformance contract.
Mesh Console is documented as a required current-Stable Glaze UI consumer but is not yet implemented or runtime-accepted.

Mesh now catalogs Wardveil Security as the authority for security/protection status, evidence semantics, and protection presentation and records the canonical Wardveil status schema as the expected contract source.

The source foundation defaults to loopback-only HTTP, fail-closed relationship policy, bounded JSON input, restrictive state-file permissions, explicit authority boundaries, and a source-level trust abstraction; approved Wardveil runtime adapter evidence remains pending.
Mesh now catalogs GoreeCloud Privacy Shield as the privacy authority and records the platform privacy contract as the expected source for adapter/conformance integration.

The architecture limits Mesh to coordination metadata, prohibits unnecessary application payload centralization, and includes source-level privacy/retention governance; approved Privacy Shield runtime adapter and retention evidence remain pending.

Mesh now catalogs Everkeep as the authority for resilience, recovery, preservation, portability, succession, and digital-legacy evidence and records the continuity status schema as the expected contract source.

The initial store uses atomic durable JSON persistence and source-level recovery readiness requires export, backup, restore, and verification evidence; production backup/export/restore and recovery acceptance remain pending.
